note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: two dated outbound customs records with destination (Vietnam), HS code and B/L number are visible in the free ImportKey view, and the buyer list shows Indian-side counterparties including HBL POWER SYSTEMS LIMITED and HBL ENGINEERING LIMITED plus AMAN AVIATION AND AEROSPACE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED, which indicates Indian domestic dealings, but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record could be retrieved (thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia 403, volza 403, and web_search was unavailable — searx connection refused), so domestic_status is left unknown rather than declared_only. HS note: the declared codes 841181/841191/880330 do not match the codes actually seen on the records (88073010, 90328990, 85443000, 84833000, 85176290) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS field should be corrected to the observed codes. Industry claim "Энергетика" is not supported by the shipment evidence, which is helicopter/aircraft parts and avionics for non-scheduled airline operations. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the free view, not estimated. No CIN/PAN asserted; the CIN in the attempted registry URL was not verified and is not reported.
